proposals.evidence: DEDR 5151 full article: Ka. yā-, ā-, ē-, e- interrogative base; yā, yāva, ā, āva, dāva, ē, e what, which; yār, ār, dāru who ( pl. ); yāvanu, āvaṃ, āve which man; yāvaḷu, āvaḷ which woman; āvudu what, which; pl. āvuvu; yāke, yātake,… The article gives Kannada yār/ār “who”; Census ārā is the human interrogative.
